record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Deliver<WH02502><WTH8761> me, O LORD<WH03068>, from the evil<WH07451> man<WH0120>: preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> me from the violent<WH02555> man<WH0376>; <RF>violent...: Heb. man of violences<Rf>

Keep<WH08104><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068>, from the hands<WH03027> of the wicked<WH07563>; preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> me from the violent<WH02555> man<WH0376>; who have purposed<WH02803><WTH8804> to overthrow<WH01760><WTH8800> my goings<WH06471>.

The proud<WH01343> have hid<WH02934><WTH8804> a snare<WH06341> for me, and cords<WH02256>; they have spread<WH06566><WTH8804> a net<WH07568> by the wayside<WH03027><WH04570>; they have set<WH07896><WTH8804> gins<WH04170> for me. Selah<WH05542>.
I said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto the LORD<WH03068>, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my God<WH0410>: hear<WH0238><WTH8685> the voice<WH06963> of my supplications<WH08469>, O LORD<WH03068>.
O GOD<WH03069> the Lord<WH0136>, the strength<WH05797> of my salvation<WH03444>, thou hast covered<WH05526><WTH8804> my head<WH07218> in the day<WH03117> of battle<WH05402>.<CM>

Grant<WH05414><WTH8799> not, O LORD<WH03068>, the desires<WH03970> of the wicked<WH07563>: further<WH06329><WTH8686> not his wicked device<WH02162>; <FI>lest<Fi> they exalt<WH07311><WTH8799> themselves. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>lest...: or, let them not be exalted<Rf>
<FI> As for<Fi> the head<WH07218> of those that compass me about<WH04524>, let the mischief<WH05999> of their own lips<WH08193> cover<WH03680><WTH8762> them.

Let burning coals<WH01513> fall<WH04131><WTH8735><WTH8675><WH04131><WTH8686> upon them: let them be cast<WH05307><WTH8686> into the fire<WH0784>; into deep pits<WH04113>, that they rise not up again<WH06965><WTH8799>.

Let not an evil speaker<WH0376><WH03956> be established<WH03559><WTH8735> in the earth<WH0776>: evil<WH07451> shall hunt<WH06679><WTH8799> the violent<WH02555> man<WH0376> to overthrow<WH04073> <FI>him<Fi> . <RF>an...: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted to his overthrow<Rf>
I know<WH03045><WTH8804> that the LORD<WH03068> will maintain<WH06213><WTH8799> the cause<WH01779> of the afflicted<WH06041>, <FI>and<Fi> the right<WH04941> of the poor<WH034>.
